name: carta-crm
description: Manage the Carta CRM conversationally — search, add, update, and enrich investors, companies, contacts, deals, notes, and fundraisings via the Carta CRM MCP Server
problem: Keeping the CRM current means clicking through forms one record at a time, and the relationship intelligence already in it — who we know at a target, what was said last, who can open a door — stays buried when a dealmaker has two minutes before a call.
